brain.commentary: Cross-asset conditions are risk-on, but conviction is weak and the institutional advisory risk score is elevated. BTC is the strongest and most liquid signal, while ETH and especially SOL carry higher volatility, negative alpha, and weaker liquidity. LTC is notably unattractive. XRP, DOGE, ADA, AVAX, LINK, BCH, UNI, XLM, and ETC are fragile because their identical signals are unsupported by zero-volatility, zero-expected-shortfall, and zero-liquidity inputs; treat them as data-quality-limited rather than genuine conviction.
